You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0242.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

args.command:
cat > /tmp/build_mol.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np

rw=Chem.RWMol(); idx={}; pts={}
def atom(name, el, x,y):
    idx[name]=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el)); pts[name]=(x/100,-y/100,0)
def bond(a,b,order=1):
    rw.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],{1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE}[order])
# macrocycle; carbon numbering is conventional erythromycin numbering
for n,x,y in [(1,420,703),(2,523,763),(3,627,703),(4,627,583),(5,731,523),(6,731,403),(7,627,343),(8,627,223),(9,523,163),(10,420,223),(11,420,343),(12,316,403),(13,316,523)]:atom(f'C{n}','C',x,y)
atom('O14','O',420,583)
for n in range(1,13):bond(f'C{n}',f'C{n+1}')
bond('C13','O14');bond('O14','C1')
for name,el,x,y,parent,bo in [
('O1','O',350,743,'C1',2),('O9','O',523,90,'C9',2),
('M2','C',523,842,'C2',1),('M4','C',560,520,'C4',1),
('M6','C',808,403,'C6',1),('OH6','O',770,338,'C6',1),
('M8','C',679,193,'C8',1),('M10','C',353,184,'C10',1),
('OH11','O',484,380,'C11',1),('OH12','O',279,340,'C12',1),
('M12','C',230,403,'C12',1),('E13','C',212,583,'C13',1),('E13M','C',146,545,'E13',1),
('OL','O',731,763,'C3',1),('OD','O',834,583,'C5',1)]:
    atom(name,el,x,y);bond(parent,name,bo)
# Cladinose sugar
for name,el,x,y in [('L1','C',731,883),('L2','C',627,943),('L3','C',627,1063),('L4','C',731,1123),('L5','C',835,1063),('LO','O',835,943),('LM3','C',580,1145),('LOM3','O',550,1063),('LOMC3','C',460,1063),('LOH4','O',731,1190),('LM5','C',893,1097)]:atom(name,el,x,y)
for a,b in [('OL','L1'),('L1','L2'),('L2','L3'),('L3','L4'),('L4','L5'),('L5','LO'),('LO','L1'),('L3','LM3'),('L3','LOM3'),('LOM3','LOMC3'),('L4','LOH4'),('L5','LM5')]:bond(a,b)
# Desosamine sugar
for name,el,x,y in [('D1','C',955,583),('D2','C',1015,687),('D3','C',1135,687),('D4','C',1195,583),('D5','C',1135,479),('DO','O',1015,479),('DOH2','O',976,754),('DN3','N',1175,757),('DNM1','C',1130,835),('DNM2','C',1260,762),('DM5','C',1175,420)]:atom(name,el,x,y)
for a,b in [('OD','D1'),('D1','D2'),('D2','D3'),('D3','D4'),('D4','D5'),('D5','DO'),('DO','D1'),('D2','DOH2'),('D3','DN3'),('DN3','DNM1'),('DN3','DNM2'),('D5','DM5')]:bond(a,b)
mol=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
# local solid/dashed stereobonds, +1 coming out of the image, -1 going in
stereo={
 'C2':{'M2':1},'C3':{'OL':-1},'C4':{'M4':-1},'C5':{'OD':-1},
 'C6':{'OH6':1,'M6':-1},'C8':{'M8':-1},'C10':{'M10':1},
 'C11':{'OH11':1},'C12':{'OH12':1,'M12':-1},'C13':{'E13':-1},
 'L1':{'OL':-1},'L3':{'LM3':1,'LOM3':-1},'L4':{'LOH4':-1},'L5':{'LM5':1},
 'D1':{'OD':-1},'D2':{'DOH2':1},'D3':{'DN3':-1},'D5':{'DM5':-1}}
for center,subs in stereo.items():
    test=Chem.Mol(mol)
    conf=Chem.Conformer(test.GetNumAtoms())
    for name,i in idx.items():conf.SetAtomPosition(i,pts[name])
    for name,z in subs.items():
        x,y,_=pts[name];conf.SetAtomPosition(idx[name],(x,y,z*0.9))
    test.AddConformer(conf)
    Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(test,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
    tag=test.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[center]).GetChiralTag()
    assert tag!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED,center
    mol.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[center]).SetChiralTag(tag)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
print('SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
for name in stereo:
    a=mol.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[name]); print(name,a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol,'structure.mol')
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=0242 if False else 242
params.numThreads=0;params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True;params.useMacrocycle14config=True
params.pruneRmsThresh=0.5
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol,numConfs=32,params=params)
print('Embedded',len(cids),flush=True)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol,numThreads=0,maxIters=2000)
energies=[(e,i,status) for i,(status,e) in enumerate(res)]
energies.sort();print('Energies',energies[:8],flush=True)
best=energies[0][1]
# Check that the minimized structure still has the intended stereochemistry.
check=Chem.Mol(mol);Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(check,confId=best,replaceExistingTags=True);Chem.AssignStereochemistry(check,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for name in stereo:
    i=idx[name]
    assert mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode')==check.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode'),name
conf=mol.GetConformer(best)
xyz=np.array(conf.GetPositions());xyz-=xyz.mean(axis=0)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\nErythromycin A; all hydrogens; MMFF94 optimized; coordinates in angstroms\n')
    for a,p in zip(mol.GetAtoms(),xyz):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
print('Saved answer.xyz')
PY
# fix octal literal in branch (python still parses it)
sed -i 's/0242 if False else 242/242/' /tmp/build_mol.py
python /tmp/build_mol.py

ls -l answer.xyz && head -n 5 answer.xyz && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('answer.xyz')
s=p.read_text().splitlines()
assert int(s[0]) == len(s)-2
print(f'Confirmed: {p.name} exists and contains {s[0]} atoms.')
PY
